question: Who won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics, and for what work?
text:
**John Clarke, Michel H. Devoret, and John M. Martinis** shared the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics “for the discovery of macroscopic quantum mechanical tunnelling and energy quantisation in an electric circuit.” ([nobelprize.org](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/2025/summary/Quantum/?utm_source=openai))

Their experiments showed that a superconducting circuit large enough to hold in your hand could tunnel through an energy barrier it couldn’t cross according to classical physics, and that it had discrete energy levels. ([nobelprize.org](https://www.nobelprize.org/uploads/2025/12/press-physicsprize2025-3.pdf?utm_source=openai))
